title: Certify Real ite terms and euf congruence claims in QF_LRA proofs
summary: The clause-log exporter and Lean reconstructor now certify QF_LRA inputs containing Real-valued ite terms, proving the ite gate clauses in Lean from ite_eq_left and ite_eq_right, and the replay tolerates the cc/comm congruence claims that euf hints carry. The unsat theorem statement is unchanged, all 28 gating CI checks passed, and the review's one minor finding (a fractional ite branch grind could not close) was fixed before merge.
